notes: GLM-4 and ChatGLM models use 'reasoning_content' as the native field for chain-of-thought reasoning, following the same pattern as OpenAI and DeepSeek. No inline thinking tags are used; reasoning is always in the structured field. GLM-5.3-Flash served by vLLM (nvidia/GLM-5.3-Flash-FP4-Local, verified 2026-10-29) puts reasoning in 'reasoning' instead (message.reasoning, and delta.reasoning when streaming); 'reasoning_content' is absent. With thinking disabled (chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false) 'reasoning' is null and the model's reasoning text can appear untagged in 'content', so it cannot be separated.

examples.name: reasoning_content field with tool calls

message.reasoning_content: The user is asking about the weather in Tokyo. I should call get_weather with location=Tokyo.

examples.expected_extracted_reasoning: The user is asking about the weather in Tokyo. I should call get_weather with location=Tokyo.
